text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Now then, how shall I tackle this?
From the front, or from behind? Hehehe...

text_block_list.name: Rival A
text_block_list.text: Rulership...!

text_block_list.name: Rival B
text_block_list.text: Not to be underestimated... Keep an eye on her...!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa. ...Don't get so worked up.
No matter how big the stage, a race is just a race... right?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(Right, if I control the pace
and calm things down around me—)

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
(An extreme pace is unlikely.
No matter how sharp Flash-san's late burst may be...)

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Ngh, the pace... doesn't suit me.
Even soâ

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
My father used to say,
'If you build something wishing for someone else's happiness, it will always reach them!'

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Right here—the showdown!!
Die Zeit ist gekommen.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Wh-Whaaaat?!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Is that Eishin!?
Eishin Flash is making her move!

text_block_list.name: Commentary
text_block_list.text:
Eishin Flash breaks away!
It's Eishin Flash!

A flash of her late-race burst. Eishin Flash tore through
Rulership's flawless strategy in a single instant...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: No... way... My strategy... shouldn't have had a single flaw.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
After planning everything so meticulously,
appearing on media outlets I hated, and training so hard...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Ahhh~, no, no, not this!
Don't I have it? The absolute strongest card for any occasion!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Nerf it, nerf it! Please nerf it already~~!
Otherwise, I'm totally not gonna play
the next pack~~.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Good work, Ruler-san.
That was magnificent.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Huh, impressive...? A-Are you mocking me...?
Flash-san was the one who won...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
No, I am not talking about the result.
When I said 'splendid,' I was referring to your—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: It is praise for precise work.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Precise... work?

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Looking back... I felt like today's race
was being controlled by you.
Most likely...

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"You were the only one
who could see the whole race, weren't you?"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"In the end, I was the one who won.
However, this Derby was—"

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
"I almost feel as though this is a masterpiece
born of your exquisite craftsmanship."

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: You too—no, precisely because you were there for me—

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text:
I believe this Derby had the potential
to become the greatest in history.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Flash-san...
Y-You think so...?
Well, maybe that is the case~.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Heh... Let us gather around the table again.
After all, our game has only just begun.

text_block_list.name: Eishin Flash
text_block_list.text: —Yes.
"Our game has only just begun"... huh...
Ooooh~~~, that's so cool~~~!!

The Umamusume watching nearby were also
completely captivated by their exchange.
And so, the curtain fell on the Tokyo Yushun (Japanese Derby).

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Traaaiineer~...
I overdid it waaaay too much~~~.
My whole body is totally falling apart...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
My HP and MP are both at zero,
so I kinda don't wanna do anything for a while...
choice_data_list: You really did great out there. Here, have some snacks and juice.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, this really hits the spot...
Long live junk food...!

"Not only did she use her head, but she also pushed her body to the absolute limit in this 'Japanese Derby'.
It's no wonder she's completely exhausted."

However, the bare minimum decisions
still had to be made.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
The next... goal...
Guhhh...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Oh, right... Needless to say,
we are giving the Kikuka Sho a hard pass.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Because I've cut out all of my long-distance training entirely.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text: Give me as long an interval as possible, and pick a race where the competition isn't too tough, please.

"...If we're not running in the 'Kikuka Sho',
there's no need to rush so much.
Which means..."
choice_data_list: How about something like the Challenge Cup in early December?

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"The Challenge Cup...
A 2,000m GIII, huh?"

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
Right. First, let's make sure you've completely recovered from the fatigue,
and we'll restart from there.

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
And so... that's enough gaming for now.
Catch ya later, logging off...

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"I just wanna hole up in my room...
But even going home... is too much of a drag..."
choice_data_list: Here, lie on the sofa. I've got your usual pillow, too!

text_block_list.name: Rulership
text_block_list.text:
"Zzzzzzzzz...
Snnnnooooore...!"

She must have been completely exhausted.
She collapsed straight into sleep, but...
choice_data_list: Fall will be a new game again
Fall will be a new game again, huh?

text_block_list.text:
Savoring the lingering afterglow of the greatest Derby in history,
they moved on toward the next season.
